profile.headline: M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence & Robotics Student | Mobile Robotics | Data Analysis | Machine Learning
profile.short_bio: Master’s student in Artificial Intelligence & Robotics at the University of Technology Nuremberg with a foundation in mechanical engineering.
profile.long_bio: A B.Tech graduate in Mechanical Engineering from Narayana Engineering College and current M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence & Robotics student at the University of Technology Nuremberg. Professional experience includes robotics prototyping as a Design Engineer at Robomonk.ai, manufacturing/process improvement as a Graduate Engineer Trainee at Amber Enterprises, leadership as President of the Robotic Society of India student chapter, and internships across IoT, automotive assembly, and refinery operations. Interested in mobile robotics, data analysis, machine learning, Industry 4.0, and industrial engineering.

projects.tittle: Mapping Urban Change in Nuremberg with Machine Learning
projects.subtittle: Geospatial ML workflow for land-cover and urban-change prediction
projects.summary: Built a geospatial machine learning workflow to predict land-cover composition and urban change using Sentinel-2 imagery, ESA WorldCover, and WorldPop data.
projects.problem: Urban-change analysis requires combining satellite imagery, population data, and land-cover labels into a reproducible modelling workflow.
projects.solution: Engineered a preprocessing pipeline across 43,281 grid cells of 100m x 100m for 2019-2023 analysis and evaluated Linear Regression, Ridge, Elastic Net, Extra Trees, and LightGBM.
projects.impact: Best model achieved R2 = 0.915 for built-up and R2 = 0.923 for vegetation.
projects.tech_stack: Python, machine learning, geospatial analysis, Sentinel-2, ESA WorldCover, WorldPop, Linear Regression, Ridge, Elastic Net, Extra Trees, LightGBM

projects.subtittle: Data pipeline for analysing Redshift query workloads
projects.summary: Designed a data pipeline to analyse Redshift query workloads across provisioned and serverless deployments.
projects.problem: Raw Redshift workload data needed cleaning, normalisation, interval reconstruction, and useful deployment-level utilisation analysis.
projects.solution: Cleaned and normalised workload data, reconstructed query execution intervals, and implemented overlap-aware aggregation in fixed 5-minute windows.
projects.impact: Generated frontend-ready utilisation datasets at deployment and instance level, stored in Parquet and DuckDB.
projects.tech_stack: Python, SQL, data pipelines, Redshift, Parquet, DuckDB, workload analytics

projects.subtittle: Joystick-controlled assistive wheelchair with sensor-based monitoring
projects.summary: Designed a joystick-controlled smart wheelchair with sensor-based monitoring for temperature and basic health parameters.
projects.problem: Mobility-assistive systems need reliable user control, sensor integration, and practical mechanical-electrical system design.
projects.solution: Implemented joystick-controlled mobility, sensor-based monitoring, an automated storage box mechanism, and supporting control logic.
projects.impact: Built practical experience in system integration, sensor interfacing, actuator control, and assistive automation.
projects.tech_stack: Embedded systems, sensors, actuator control, joystick control, mechanical design, robotics prototyping

projects.tittle: Design and Development of Multi-Purpose Drone
projects.summary: Designed and developed a versatile unmanned aerial vehicle capable of carrying a payload of up to 1.5 kg.
projects.problem: The project aimed to create a flexible UAV platform suitable for aerial photography, payload delivery, and multi-purpose applications.
projects.solution: Used Pixhawk 2.4.8 for control and navigation and engineered the drone as a multi-purpose UAV platform.
projects.impact: Demonstrated applied robotics, control, navigation, payload design, and mechanical integration work.
projects.tech_stack: UAV systems, Pixhawk 2.4.8, control, navigation, payload design, robotics
